items.t: Said prioritizing civics education gives students the tools to be informed, engaged, and patriotic citizens.
items.q: By prioritizing robust civics education, we are giving our students the tools to be informed, engaged, and patriotic citizens.

items.t: Said Missouri will continue to lead in supporting the military and advocating for veterans.
items.q: Missouri will continue to lead the way in supporting our military, advocating for our veterans, and inspiring the next generation of service.

items.t: Supports standing up for Missouri's veterans so they receive the care, benefits, and respect they have earned.
items.q: Standing up for Missouri’s veterans to guarantee they receive the care, benefits, and respect they’ve earned.

items.t: Said it is imperative never to forget the debt owed to veterans.
items.q: Their dedication and sacrifice pave the way for the freedoms we enjoy today, and it’s imperative that we never forget the debt we owe them.

items.t: Said Missouri's citizens deserve leaders who will fight for hardworking families and stand up for veterans and seniors.
items.q: The citizens of our state deserve leaders who will fight for hardworking families, stand up for our veterans and seniors, and ensure our communities thrive.

record.t: Hosted the Missouri Veterans Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony at the State Capitol.
record.q: In November, he hosted the Missouri Veterans Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony at the State Capitol, honoring six veterans and one honorary inductee for their military service and community leadership.

record.t: Was sworn into office as Lieutenant Governor.
record.q: Sworn into office on January 13, 2025, Lt. Governor Wasinger led efforts this year to enhance senior protection, expand veterans’ services, and promote economic growth.

record.t: Hosted a statewide "Protect Our Seniors" Tour through his office.
record.q: His office hosted a statewide “Protect Our Seniors” Tour, bringing together families, legal experts, local officials, and representatives of the Attorney General’s Medicaid Fraud Control Unit to raise awareness of elder abuse and strengthen oversight.

record.t: Met with U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins to discuss veterans services coordination.
record.q: Lt. Governor Wasinger also met with U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins to discuss improving coordination on veterans services

record.t: Served on several state boards and commissions, including the Missouri Tourism Commission and the Missouri Housing Development Commission.
record.q: Throughout the year, Lt. Governor Wasinger also served on several boards and commissions, including the Missouri Tourism Commission, Missouri Housing Development Commission, Missouri Development Finance Board, Board of Public Buildings, and Missouri State Capitol Commission
On November 5, 2024, David Wasinger was elected to serve as Missouri’s 49th Lieutenant Governor.

record.office: Curator of the University of Missouri
record.t: Was appointed to the Board of Curators of the University of Missouri by Governor Matt Blunt.
record.q: previously served on the Board of Curators of the University of Missouri, where he was appointed by Governor Matt Blunt.

record.t: Released the 2026 Buy Missouri Holiday Gift Guide.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor David Wasinger officially released the 2026 Buy Missouri Holiday Gift Guide, a curated showcase of unique, high-quality products crafted by small businesses, manufacturers, and artisans

record.t: Joined U.S. Department of Education officials and state education leaders at the "History Rocks" event series on civics and history education.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor David Wasinger joined officials from the U.S. Department of Education and state education leaders to emphasize the critical importance of civics and history education during the “History Rocks” event series.
